Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		existing: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid),
		isNew: Boolean = if existing.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		requestid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		loanamount.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		loanpurpose.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		income.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		phonenumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		postaladdress.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		zipcode.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		email.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		workreferences.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		creditreferences.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		checkingaccountnumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		securitynumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->isUnique(o: LoanRequest|o.RequestID)
	postcondition:
		if isNew 
		then let newRequest: LoanRequest in
		newRequest.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(newRequest) and
		newRequest.RequestID = requestid and
		newRequest.Name = name and
		newRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		newRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		newRequest.Income = income and
		newRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		newRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		newRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and
		newRequest.Email = email and
		newRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		newRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		newRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		newRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		newRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = newRequest and
		result = true 
		else self.CurrentLoanRequest = existing and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
